rules.check: Average characters per rendered line, in text blocks of 3+ lines
rules.applies_to: Latin prose blocks; not captions, CJK or display titles

rules.check: line-height ÷ font-size
rules.threshold: body warn under 1.2 or over 1.8; display warn over 1.3
rules.applies_to: Latin body/display text; check script-specific leading (§10)

rules.check: Smallest text at delivered size
rules.threshold: web body ≥16 px; iOS body ≥17 pt; choose smaller labels by medium and viewing conditions; 1080 × 1920 captions ≥48 px; 1080-wide social graphic body ≥36 px
rules.applies_to: scoped web/iOS body and fixed-size social/video defaults

rules.check: Source foreground/background colours plus displayed size; visual delivery review separately
rules.threshold: WCAG AA target: ≥4.5:1, ≥3:1 for large text at ≥24 CSS px or ≥18.66 CSS px bold; APCA supplementary, size/weight-dependent (§8)
rules.applies_to: declared web accessibility target; adapted readability target for other media, not a conformance claim

rules.check: Suspect punctuation and spacing in prose
rules.threshold: flag for language-aware review; preserve code, identifiers, literal quotations and intentional notation
rules.applies_to: prose in the selected locale; never blanket replacement

rules.check: Family count, synthesised styles, manifest
rules.threshold: ≤3 families; no faux bold/italic; every font listed with source, version and licence

rules.check: Numbers that change or align use `tnum`; small caps only if `smcp` exists; justified text has `lang` and hyphenation
rules.applies_to: fonts and scripts supporting the feature; hyphenation only where appropriate to the language

rules.check: Last line of a heading or title
rules.threshold: not a single word and not under ~15% of the measure

rules.check: 200% zoom and WCAG 1.4.12 overrides
rules.applies_to: web pages only, not fixed-size frames

rules.check: Text boxes against safe-area rectangles
rules.threshold: 16:9: EBU graphics safe 5%; 9:16: composite 288 top, 672 bottom, 65 left, 192 right; Meta 14/35/6

rules.check: Caption reading speed
rules.applies_to: Netflix English (USA) profile; other languages/deliveries need their own profile
rules.source: Netflix English (USA) Timed Text Style Guide [112]; caption_profiles.netflix-en-us

rules.check: Characters per line and line count
rules.applies_to: selected caption delivery profile; vertical allowance unverified

rules.check: Event duration and gap
rules.tier: standard (duration) / heuristic (gap; no longer on Netflix's current pages)
rules.source: Netflix Timed Text Style Guide: General Requirements [114]; caption_profiles.netflix-en-us

rules.check: Hold after the text settles
Flashes per second
rules.threshold: conservative default: ≤3 in any one-second window; full WCAG 2.3.1 also permits flashes below general/red-flash thresholds

rules.check: Print preflight
rules.threshold: K100 for text under ~18 pt; reverses ≥8–10 pt; hairlines ≥0.25–0.5 pt; 3–5 mm from trim; fonts embedded

rules.check: Render at target sizes and inspect: phone-size frame, thumbnail, print at 100%; blur test
Font files, licences and manifest travel with the project
Fonts loaded and confirmed before window.__scene is exposed
Chroma subsampling smear on saturated text
Fine detail lost to platform re-encoding
Colour matrix, range and tags on encode
rules.source: §15.3 [121][122]; not covered by the ffmpeg-ffprobe evidence

rules.check: Text softened by scaling a composited layer
rules.source: §15.4; general Chromium behaviour, not tested in VCR

rules.check: Stagger onsets quantised to frame boundaries
Lossless delivery format for text-heavy stills

tiktok.source: §9d agent default composite; TikTok publishes no pixel margins and third-party figures disagree [84][85][86][87]

composite-9x16.source: §9d agent default: the most conservative of the TikTok, Reels and Shorts figures

netflix-en-us.source: Netflix English (USA) Timed Text Style Guide [112] and General Requirements [114]; vertical lines from unverified BBC guidance; the gap was removed from Netflix's pages in 2020
